units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3:10">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᶜ</cite> top <he>יהבון מ׳ וכ׳</he> fasten a rope to my feet; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 12:3:10">Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>יבון משיחא בריגלי</he> (not <he>בריגלו</he>).—Y. Kil. l. c. bot. (R. Meir said before his death) <he>הא מְשִׁיחֲכוֹן דידכון</he> this is your band (the attraction of Palestine made me travel all the way to die there); Y. Keth. l. c. bot. <he>די דא מ׳ וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.).
